##### Project general facts

Minati Homes 1 is a striking residential development that brings modern elegance and refined comfort to Al Furjan. The project offers a wide selection of thoughtfully designed 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, and 3.5 bedroom apartments, each crafted with stylish interiors, maximum space efficiency, and a contemporary touch. Natural light floods every residence, enhancing the sense of openness while sleek architecture and Vastu-inspired layouts create a perfect balance of beauty and function.

Living at Minati Homes 1 means having access to a lifestyle elevated by premium amenities designed for relaxation, wellness, and entertainment. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool, shaded yoga area, and children’s play zone, as well as his and hers steam rooms and a state-of-the-art gym. Social and leisure spaces include a poolside open-air cinema, co-working lounges, recreational rooms, and a barbeque pod, ensuring that every day feels like a retreat.

Set in a prime location with seamless connectivity, Minati Homes 1 ensures convenience at every turn. The project is just minutes from Sheikh Zayed Road, the Dubai Metro, and world-famous destinations. Combining stylish design, premium amenities, and an unbeatable location, Minati Homes 1 truly redefines the art of sophisticated living in Dubai.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
